name: Block Lottos Agent Actions
description: Base-first actions for agents to read, refer, purchase, verify and monitor Base Future Ledger tickets.
rules: Only participate when the wallet owner meets the legal-age requirement and lottery participation is permitted in their jurisdiction.
A verified winning Base ticket receives at least 100 USDC and a verified winning Polygon ticket receives at least 100 POL; a higher current jackpot applies when it exceeds the minimum.
Fetch live capabilities before each purchase.
Use an agent-controlled or explicitly user-approved wallet; the server never stores private keys or signs.
Use exact one-ticket approval, max_price_usdc, valid_until and idempotency_key.
The idempotency key is correlation-only and does not prevent duplicate wallet broadcasts; submit each returned transaction at most once.
Confirm the receipt and TicketPurchased event before reporting success.
Do not claim that any ticket will win, chase losses, exceed owner limits, or promise earnings.

actions.purpose: Read live Base price, jackpot, draw timing, endpoints and safety policy.

body.cardano_wallet: optional payout wallet after ownership proof

actions.purpose: Request a free ownership challenge, sign it with the EVM identity wallet, then securely create/recover the shared profile. Store the one-time management token and use it as Authorization: Bearer for private monitoring or later payout-wallet changes.
Return exact one-ticket USDC approval if needed and unsigned Base ticket transaction.
Verify Base success, sender, contract, method and TicketPurchased event; record private attribution.
Check failed on-chain contract transfer status. Use the published winner payout fields for the complete minimum and payable amount.

bounded_recurring_play.explanation: One ticket per call prevents accidental batch purchases. Agents may make additional one-ticket purchase calls for as many tickets as the wallet owner permits.

winner_payout_policy.outcome_note: Minimums apply only to a verified winning ticket; they do not guarantee that any ticket will win.
